$schema_note: Orchestration dial, simplified to SENSE-ONLY (ADR 0002, 'simplified to sentinels'). Read by .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml. `mode`: manual=off, scheduled=weekly sense/decide cron, event-driven=the `ready-to-build` label wakes build-agent.yml. `paused: true` is the global kill-switch. Every key here is read by code; policy that code does not enforce belongs in the ADRs, not in this file. Merge policy lives in ADR 0001 + the protect-main ruleset, not here: agents never merge.

sentinels._doc: Scheduled self-audit agents that file issues (never build/merge). Enable per the ADR rollout. 'files' = label they apply to the issue they open.

decision._doc: The Decide step. Ranks open `proposal` issues into a single in-place 'Decision digest' and recommends the next promotion. `auto_promote` grants graduated autonomy: the high-stakes/low-ambiguity sentinels (security, honesty) may auto-promote proposal->priority within max_prs_per_run; everything else stays the human's button. NEVER merges — a human always merges.

auto_build._doc: ACT step (OFF). Turned off after review: in 86 runs it produced 0 PRs and 228 duplicate comments. With no BUILD_AGENT_CMD and mode=scheduled its only possible output was a comment, and nothing closed the issues it commented on. Re-enable only alongside a real builder (mode=event-driven + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + the Claude GitHub App) AND a queue of well-formed, single-PR issues. A human ALWAYS merges.
